summary: Show computer-pushed monochrome photos in awake or scheduled slideshow modes.
page_description: Turn a Kobo into a low-power monochrome photo frame with bounded, owner-pushed albums and awake or scheduled slideshow modes.
release_notes: Review an album before it is transferred, compare crop against pad, and keep the album you had if a transfer is interrupted. A transfer is reported as done only after the reader confirms what it holds.

steps.text: Enable Cobalt's owner-attended SSH path and install this computer's public key.
Create Frame's private shelf through the established SSH connection.
Prepare and atomically push a photo or folder from this computer.

user: Somebody who wants their Kobo to hold a photo on the shelf or desk.
job: Show photos pushed from your computer, as a still or a scheduled slideshow.
offline: Everything works without the network; photos arrive from your computer, never the internet.

data.kind: the photos you push from your computer
data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the originals stay on your computer

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; re-setting them takes a moment

capabilities_optional.name: scheduled-wake
capabilities_optional.gates: waking the reader for a scheduled show

non_goals: It does not fetch photos from the internet.
It does not edit your photos.
